title: The 4 Best Pressure Washers Under $300
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for pressure washers under $300, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pressure washers under $300 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Karcher K5 Premium Full Control Plus
products.blurb: Key specs: 2000 PSI, 1.4 GPM, Typically $250 to $290, Water-cooled induction motor.
strengths: Water-cooled induction motor is rated for a meaningfully longer service life than the brushed motors in cheaper units
Vario Power wand adjusts pressure without swapping nozzles, the most convenient control scheme in this list
Two-year warranty is longer than most competitors in this category, reflecting brand confidence in long-term durability
limitations: 1.4 GPM flow is lower than the Sun Joe SPX3000's 1.76 GPM, so rinsing large areas takes a bit longer
Priced close to the top of this budget tier
Overkill for buyers who only pressure wash a couple times a year

products.name: Greenworks Pro 2300 PSI Brushless Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2300 max PSI, 2.3 GPM max flow, Typically $170 to $200, TruBrushless motor.
strengths: Highest PSI and GPM combination of any electric pick in this list, meaningfully faster on driveways and larger decks
Brushless motor is quieter and more durable than standard brushed designs, at a lower price than the Karcher K5
limitations: No adjustable Vario-style wand, pressure control depends on nozzle swaps
Shorter warranty coverage than the Karcher K5
Bulkier frame than the compact budget models

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3000 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2030 max PSI, 1.76 GPM max flow, Typically $130 to $150, Dual detergent tanks.
strengths: Dual detergent tanks are a genuine convenience not matched by either step-up pick here
limitations: Lower PSI and GPM than the Karcher K5 or Greenworks Pro 2300
Standard brushed motor and plastic housing, not built to the same durability spec as the Karcher

products.name: RYOBI 2500 PSI 1.2 GPM Brushless Electric Pressure Washer
strengths: Enough pressure for decks and siding
limitations: Use wide tips on soft wood

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
